name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause Existence(door_open) is redundant. The task commands the order 'Open the door. Pick up the box', which is correctly captured by the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) and the hard Existence(target_picked_up). Together, these force door_open to occur before target_picked_up, making an explicit Existence(door_open) unnecessary and repeating what the chain already forces. Remove Existence(door_open); keep Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up).
